subject: Storify embed migration & architecture: dim / batching / auth next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@storify-retail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Storify pilot follow-up — embeddings migration & infra questions

Hi Alex — great call today, thanks for the context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs (from call)
- Current vectors: VecStore (third-party) at 384 dims, indexed in-house.
- Goal: migrate to Redwood embeddings (better similarity & reranker integration), target query relevance improvements across product search and recommendations.
- Constraints: tight per-request cost target, compliance (S3 + audit logs), and a one-month pilot timeline.

Technical uncertainties we flagged
- Target vector dimension: you mentioned 1536 as ideal for accuracy. We should validate cost/latency tradeoffs vs 1024.
- Batching & throughput: expected query QPS ~450 peak; unclear write/ingest cadence.
- Normalization & similarity: you currently use cosine on raw VecStore vectors — need to confirm policy on L2-normalize at index vs query time.
- Auth & routing: whether you want a single service account for the pilot or per-environment keys.

Proposed next steps (can start this week)
1) Share a small sample (5k rows) export of existing vectors + source text (S3 link or Drive). We only need id, text, existing_vector for a shadow run.
2) Redwood will run a conversion and pilot: produce embeddings at 1536 and 1024, run a quick reranker A/B on your evaluation set.
3) Architecture deep-dive (60 min) — schedule with your eng leads to lock on batching, auth, routing, fallback model variants. Suggested times: Thu 6/19 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 6/20 09:00–10:00 PT.

Attachments: 20250618-call-notes.pdf (call highlights), pilot-benchmark-config.yaml (baseline settings we plan to run).

Ask: Can you grant a read-only S3 role or upload the sample to the Drive link above? If you prefer, we can accept an anonymized CSV.

I'll also loop in Marcus (infra) to sketch sizing recommendations once we see the sample. Rafael and Priyom copied for commercial and integration lead alignment.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

From: Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@storify-retail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@storify-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storify pilot follow-up — embeddings migration & infra questions

Naomi — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Current state: VecStore exports available; vectors are 384 dims. We also store a small eval set of 2k labeled query→relevant items.
- Preference: we'd like to try 1536 if cost is acceptable, but we asked about 1024 because we've seen decent lifts and lower cost elsewhere.
- Ingest cadence: nightly full reindex (hour-long window), plus nearline updates (low-volume). Peak QPS is spiky — Black Friday-like loads could be much higher; we'll need autoscale guidance.
- Security: we prefer a single service account for pilot that can be rotated monthly. Audit logs must be forwarded to our SIEM (we can provide endpoint).

Can Redwood provide a migration script example and an estimate of tokens/requests cost for 5k->1536 conversion? Also — is there a standard MSA you send for pilots? We have a procurement cycle (procurement@storify-retail.com) that may want an early DocuSign to lock terms.

We will upload an anonymized 5k CSV to the Drive folder you shared by EOD tomorrow.

— Alex
Head of Search & Recommendations
Storify Retail

Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storify pilot follow-up — embeddings migration & infra questions

Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two quick answers, plus a proposed pilot plan below.

1) Migration script & cost estimate
- We'll provide a small Python conversion script as a starting point (see sample in attachments). Rough cost estimate for converting 5k texts -> 1536 embeddings: ~5k * 1 request each; token volume depends on average doc size. I'll get precise token estimates after we inspect the CSV.

2) MSA / procurement
- We can share a short pilot MSA via DocuSign; Rafael will handle commercial terms and can fast-track a pilot SOW once we have the sample.

Proposed pilot (3 phases, 3 weeks)
- Phase 1 (week 0): Dataset ingest & conversion — run 5k->1536 and 5k->1024. Validate quality on your 2k eval set.
- Phase 2 (week 1): Index + reranker integration — test latency/throughput using your QPS profile; tune batching and caching.
- Phase 3 (week 2): Production-like stress + migration playbook — cutover runbook and rollback plan; handoff docs.

Technical defaults we'll start with (can be tuned after dataset)
- Model: embed-v2 (1536) / embed-v2-1024 (projection)
- Batching: SDK default with target batch size 128 for CPU agents; 256 for GPU-backed ingest.
- Normalization: L2 normalize at index time; do cosine at query-time.
- Auth: use a single service account key for the pilot; we support short-lived keys and KMS-backed rotation if you want more controls.

Quick example (Redwood SDK pseudocode)
- curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDWOOD_API_KEY>" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"embed-v2","input":["your document text"]}'

Attachments: pilot-benchmark-config.yaml (baseline settings), 20250618-call-notes.pdf. Rafael — could you please share the pilot SOW template and a sample MSA/Docusign link?

I'll tentatively book Thu 6/19 10:00 PT for the architecture deep-dive; Sarah, can you make that time?

Best —
Naomi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@storify-retail.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@storify-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storify pilot follow-up — embeddings migration & infra questions

Looping in some infra details from my side (short technical note). Thanks for the sample upload in advance — that will drive final numbers.

Sizing & dims
- Recommendation: run both 1536 and 1024. If cost is a gating factor, we can store 1536 in cold storage and project to 1024 for query time (PCA/Projection) so you get accuracy wins for reindexing windows and lower inference cost for high-QPS queries.

Batching & throughput
- For ingest: we recommend batching writes in groups of 512 on GPU nodes (lower RPC overhead) and 128 on CPU nodes. For online queries, target a batch size of 64 for low-latency paths and allow larger batched background queries.

Normalization & similarity
- Index-time L2 normalization + cosine similarity at query will give consistent results and is compatible with ANN indexes. Avoid double-normalizing.

Auth & routing
- Use a dedicated service-account key scoped to the Storify pilot project. Exchange for short-lived tokens via our token service for app servers. Route embedding writes to embed-v2 and queries to embed-v2-ops which are optimized for 1–2ms token overhead. Add a fallback route to embed-v1-legacy if capacity constraints happen.

Migration notes
- Provide S3 read role (ARN) for the sample export. We can run the conversion in your region to avoid cross-region egress.
- We'll provide a small CLI tool to convert VecStore vectors -> Redwood format; it preserves id mappings and emits a migration manifest for rollbacks.

Estimated artifacts I'll produce after sample ingest
- embed-sizing-estimates.csv (attached): per-dimension cost and throughput projection
- migration-runbook.md: step-by-step cutover with verification checks

Example curl ingest (bulk, JSON-lines)
- curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN>" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '[{"id":"item-1","input":"text..."}, {"id":"item-2","input":"text..."}]'

I'll sync with Priyom on any SLO/monitoring hooks we should expose to Storify's ops team. Naomi — I confirm the 6/19 10:00 PT slot works for my calendar.

Marcus Lin
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
